mostWorthwhile.text: Making arthropods was most worthwhile: their jointed limbs and external skeleton gave the insect branch some biological context, including its distinct ancestry from vertebrates.

leastWorthwhile.text: The insect and winged-insect steps were predictable and offered no further explanation, making the progression feel somewhat mechanical.

surprise.text: Combining dividing cells with light produced variation rather than the light-dependent life I expected. The explanation usefully distinguished variation from changes arising because organisms need them.

arbitrary.text: Light producing variation was not obvious beforehand, although the result explained it as a gesture affecting inherited information. Every decision offered only one combination, so I wasn't discovering compatibility.

continue.text: I might continue to see what the living world develops next, but the single-option sequence and predictable final steps weakened the hook.
